methodology.winRate: Winning closing orders / (winning + losing closing orders), gross closedPnl; not independent round-trip trade win rate.
methodology.profitFactor: Gross closedPnl of winning closing orders / absolute gross closedPnl of losing closing orders; excludes fees and funding.
methodology.netRealized: Sum closedPnl minus all USDC fill fees in the observed 30-day period; excludes funding, open/unrealized PnL.
methodology.drawdown: Maximum peak-to-trough decline of cumulative realized fill PnL less USDC fees; proxy, not true account/equity max drawdown.
methodology.limits: API 2,000 fills per page, limited history; rankings hidden if <20 closing orders / <7 closing days, missing losses, or capped records. Partial closing fills grouped by order.
